description: Will a model run on this machine, and where? Uses the installed model's size and exact layer architecture when the runtime exposes it (else parameter-count or catalog estimates) to size weights + KV cache for a context length, then compares with free VRAM summed across GPUs and available RAM. Returns target gpu / partial (GPU+CPU split) / cpu / none, with the numbers and how the KV estimate was made. Credits back memory the model already uses if it is loaded.

contextLength.description: Context length for the KV-cache estimate (default 4096)

kvCacheType.description: KV cache precision: f16 (default), q8_0, q4_0

provider.description: Provider instance name. Omit to let the server choose (local providers only, unless LOCAL_AI_ALLOW_HOSTED_FALLBACK is set).

sizeBytes.description: Explicit weight size in bytes (overrides lookup)

name: fit_check
title: Fit check
